causes.label: The power supply has been disconnected.
remedies: Check whether the lighting in your kitchen or other appliances in the room are working.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "The power supply has been disconnected."

causes.label: The appliance has not been connected as shown in the circuit diagram.
remedies: Disconnect the appliance from the power supply.
Make sure the appliance has been connected as shown in the circuit diagram. There is an electronics fault ▶ If the fault cannot be eliminated, call Customer Service.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "The appliance has not been connected as shown in the circuit diagram."

causes.label: The control panel is wet or an object is covering it.
remedies: Dry the control panel or remove the object.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "The control panel is wet or an object is covering it."

causes.label: The electronics have overheated. The corresponding cooking zone has been switched off.
remedies: Wait until the electronics have cooled down sufficiently.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "The electronics have overheated. The corresponding cooking zone has been switched off."

causes.label: a When error message disappears, the electronics have cooled down sufficiently.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "a When error message disappears, the electronics have cooled down sufficiently."

causes.label: The electronics have overheated. All cooking zones have switched off.
remedies: Wait until the electronics have cooled down sufficiently.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "The electronics have overheated. All cooking zones have switched off."

causes.label: a When error message disappears, the electronics have cooled down sufficiently.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "a When error message disappears, the electronics have cooled down sufficiently."

causes.label: There is hot cookware near the control panel. The electronics are at risk of overheating.
remedies: Remove the cookware from the control panel.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "There is hot cookware near the control panel. The electronics are at risk of overheating."

causes.label: a You can continue to cook.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "a You can continue to cook."

causes.label: There is hot cookware near the control panel. The cooking zone has switched off to protect the electronics.
remedies: Remove the cookware from the control panel.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "There is hot cookware near the control panel. The cooking zone has switched off to protect the electronics."

causes.label: a When error message disappears, the electronics have cooled down sufficiently.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "a When error message disappears, the electronics have cooled down sufficiently."

causes.label: The cooking zone has been operating continuously for an extended period of time without interaction. The automatic time limitation has been triggered.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "The cooking zone has been operating continuously for an extended period of time without interaction. The automatic time limitation has been triggered."

causes.label: a You can set the cooking zone and continue to cook.

symptoms.symptom: and cooking zones do not heat up

causes.label: Demo mode is activated.
remedies: Disconnect the appliance from the power supply for 30 seconds by switching off
the circuit breaker or fuse in the electrical panel.
Touch any touch field within the next 3 minutes.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "Demo mode is activated."
